about_the_game:
Your desktop companion

Being coquettish, dozing off, and curiously looking around, she is very eager to interact with you

Desktop Charm is waiting to accompany you on your computer

Compact and suspended standing in the corner of the desktop, occupying no space and no pop ups, allowing you to focus on studying and working

Too many skins waiting for you to unlock

This cute demon can also record the number of times you use the keyboard and mouse, bringing you more surprises!

Every mouse click and keyboard input can quickly increase the points, helping the demon unlock more special costumes!

Every operation in your daily life can become the energy for the growth of succubus, making your office and study time full of comfort~

Adjust arbitrarily to suit all computer scenarios

Zoom in, zoom out, she can be anywhere on your computer

On the front and back, the charm of the demon is fully revealed

Freely shuttle through your screen, accompanying you

Remember your preference settings, and the next time you start, it will automatically return to its original position.

content_descriptors.notes: This game does not involve sexual assault/non-consensual sex, drug and alcohol abuse, or self-harm

short_description: This desktop succubus will accompany you in your life. Every time you use the keyboard or mouse, you can earn points, which can be used to unlock more costumes. Come and create your own desktop succubus~
